description:
FILED s470bq (Opus, 2026-09-05) as the DECLARED gap of #1215; stated in
docs/ir-spec.md Â§12b so a backend author reads it there.

The data form carries the LOWERED forms -- everything that reaches
`Pl::Passes::run`.  `Pl::Parser2::_assemble_sections` also pushes ~18 kinds of
hand-written TEXT line into the output, and those are not trees, so they are
not in the data form:

    ;;; package Foo            (a comment -- the data form has none)
    (p-defpackage :Foo) (in-package :Foo) (defclass â¦ () ())
    (p-register-pkg-name :Foo "Foo")
    (defvar $a (make-p-box nil))  (defvar $b â¦)
    the section's forward-global (p-defcell â¦) declarations
    the `package Foo 1.5` $VERSION block
    (p-run-compile-phase-blocks)
    (p-set-current-package :Foo "Foo")

Most are derivable by a consumer from the `(|p-bucket| SECTION :BUCKET
:PHASE)` markers plus Â§7.1 and Â§9, and Â§12b says so.  Two are NOT purely
bookkeeping and are the reason this is a task and not a note: the
forward-global `p-defcell` declarations (a program's undeclared package
globals) and `p-run-compile-phase-blocks` (the compileârun boundary, Â§9).

THE FIX IS THE RIGHT ONE STRUCTURALLY: express those lines as CLForm trees at
the assembly, which is review Â§3.1's "make CLForm the total carrier" for the
last part of the file that is still text.  It is emission-RISKY (the printed
bytes must not move), so it wants its own session with corpus-diff as the bar
-- byte-identical output while the assembly stops being a string join.
subject: --emit-sexp omits the assembly's own text lines (in-package, p-defpackage, the $a/$b and forward-global defvars, p-run-compile-phase-blocks, p-set-current-package)
